name: Shemaiah
overview: Shemaiah is a male prophet known as the man of God, a designation highlighting his role as a divine messenger. His prophetic ministry is noted specifically in the books of 1 Kings and 2 Chronicles, where he is recognized for conveying God's messages during critical moments in Israel's history. The Scriptures emphasize his identity primarily through his unique title and prophetic function.
namesAndTitles: The name Shemaiah means 'YHWH hears,' reflecting a connection to God's attentive nature. Additionally, he is referred to by the title 'man of God,' which underscores his role as one who represents and speaks for God. Both the proper name and the title emphasize his divine calling and mission.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture does not record family relationships for Shemaiah beyond what is listed in his unique attribute as the man of God. There are no additional familial or relational details provided in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Shemaiah's significance lies in his prophetic role during pivotal times in Israel's history, serving as a conduit for God's guidance. His designation as the man of God highlights his authority and divine appointment to deliver God's messages. Through his prophecies, he contributed to the spiritual direction and governance of the nation as recorded in the historical books of the Old Testament.
